Delivery planning: trips by load, routes to drivers

Orders from 1C are grouped into trips by truck capacity and area, each driver gets the route in Telegram, and every delivery is confirmed with a photo. An MVP in 4–7 weeks, from UZS 60 mln; the full version in 10–16 weeks.

Estimate it for your business

Timeline and price

Timeline
MVP 4–7 weeksFull 10–16 weeks
Price
MVP UZS 60–121 mln $5,000–10,000Full UZS 180–425 mln $15,000–35,000Rate: Central Bank of Uzbekistan, 21.10.2026, $1 = UZS 12,012
Per month
UZS 0.4–2.5 mln your own running costs: hosting, SMS and other services
Difficulty
medium
Who it is for
Distribution and wholesale, Manufacturing, Retail, Construction, E-commerce
Integrations
  • 1C
  • Yandex Maps / Google Maps / 2GIS
  • Wialon / Teltonika
  • Telegram

What you get

What the MVP includes
  • Orders pulled from 1C with weight and volume
  • Trip planning board for the dispatcher with suggestions
  • Stop order on Yandex Maps
  • Driver Telegram bot with stops, navigation link, photo proof of delivery and payment or debt notes
  • Statuses back into 1C
What the full version adds
  • Automatic route optimisation with time windows and several warehouses
  • GPS from Wialon or trackers matched to the plan
  • Delivery cost per trip and client
  • ETA messages to customers
  • Returns and reloads

What we need from you

  • How the work runs today: who does what
  • Existing data: Excel, notebooks or an old system
  • 1–2 staff to try the system

Questions

What does “Delivery planning: trips by load, routes to drivers” cost?
The MVP costs $5,000–10,000 (UZS 60–121 mln), the full version $15,000–35,000 (UZS 180–425 mln). The exact price depends on the integrations and the scope.
How long does “Delivery planning: trips by load, routes to drivers” take?
The MVP takes 4–7 weeks, the full version 10–16 weeks.
What do we need to provide?
How the work runs today: who does what; existing data: Excel, notebooks or an old system; 1–2 staff to try the system.
